brief_title: Single and Multiple Ascending Dose Study of AMG 171 in Subjects With Obesity
official_title: A Phase 1, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled, Single and Multiple Ascending Dose Study to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics of AMG 171 in Subjects With Obesity
why_stopped: Amgen determined the totality of the data does not support continuation of AMG 171 development program for treatment of Obesity. No safety concerns identified.

primary_outcomes.measure: Number of Participants Who Experienced Treatment-Emergent Adverse Events (TEAEs)
primary_outcomes.time_frame: From first dose of IP to end of study, up to Day 207

brief_summary: To assess the safety and tolerability of AMG 171 as single or multiple doses in subjects with obesity

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria

* Males and females with ages between 18 and 65 years old, inclusive
* Except for obesity, otherwise healthy
* Body mass index (BMI) greater than or equal to 30.0 kg/m2 and less than or equal to 40.0 kg/m2 at screening
* Other Inclusion criteria may apply

Exclusion Criteria:

* Currently receiving treatment in another investigational device or drug study
* Women of childbearing potential
* History or evidence of a clinically significant disorder, condition or disease that would pose a risk to subject safety or interfere with the study evaluation, procedures or completion
* Other Exclusion criteria may apply
